listing.name: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild — Switch edition (SavageWindRecomp)
listing.summary: Experimental LAS-derived static code generated locally; native Windows/Linux Vulkan runtime. Upstream maturity: Shrine/GreatPlateau only; nobody past plateau, alpha tester preview; distant-map rendering and controller/gyro validation incomplete. Acquisition: Alpha3 ZIP/AppImages launcher validates/copies data, builds image and recompiles locally; no Nintendo package/decryption workflow. Platforms: Actual Windows x64 and Linux x64 SSE4.2/Vulkan1.3 packages; AVX2/FMA optional faster mode. Linux aarch64 asset highly experimental, never real ARM hardware. Original data: Own extracted BOTW1.9.0 ExeFS(main/main.npdm/rtld/sdk/subsdk0) plus complete merged RomFS. NEVER decrypts; no keys/firmware/dump tools supplied. DLC unsupported.1.8.2 may run but explicitly unsupported. Portcove setup/gameplay untested; no operational integration offered.
